nextReadySlice.title: Publish benchmark and telemetry outputs in a reviewable format
dependsOn: Sample-app migration report review before broad rollout completed.
failingProof: A failing proof shows the repository has benchmark, build-telemetry, and invalidation artifacts, but still lacks a preserved human-review package that ties those outputs together for the scheduled/manual performance lane.
A failing proof shows the current performance evidence is dispersed across BenchmarkDotNet outputs, telemetry envelopes, and stress summaries instead of one reviewable publication bundle.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop for review if publishing the performance package requires changing the approved machine-readable artifact contracts instead of only curating and presenting the existing outputs.
